TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.name: Directional Whip Pan with 270° Motion Blur
TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.description: Rapid horizontal camera whip simulating high-speed head turn, matching movement vector between distinct scenes.
visual_prerequisites: Continuous lateral movement in source take
High contrast edges in incoming take
TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.editing_technique: 0.20s duration transition with shutter angle set to 270° for authentic cinematic streaking.
TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.suggested_audio_treatment: Fast air blast whoosh (whoosh_air_blast_clean.wav) peaking 2 frames before cut point.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: MediaIn1 -> DirectionalBlur (Length 0.08, Angle 180) -> Transform (CenterX anim 0.5 -> -0.5) -> Dissolve -> MediaIn2

TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.name: Dynamic Radial Zoom-In Snap
TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.description: Fast push-in zoom into focal point (killer or victim head) before cutting to opposite perspective.
TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.editing_technique: 0.15s duration radial scale from 1.0x to 1.4x into cut point, incoming clip starts at 1.2x and snaps to 1.0x.
TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.suggested_audio_treatment: Turbulent wind whip + sharp transient hit on impact frame.

TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.name: Luma Contrast Impact Flash
TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.description: Overexposed 2-frame brightness burst accentuating catastrophic weapon impacts or sniper shots.
TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.editing_technique: Gamma / Gain boosted to +35% for 2 frames at hit point, decaying over 4 frames.
TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.suggested_audio_treatment: Sharp metallic slice cut or snap layered with sub downer.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Node 1 -> Node 2 (Gain Keyframe: f0=1.0, f2=1.45, f5=1.0) -> Output
